source.basis: local Humble rebuild from R2FU and ros2cs sources

knownCaveats: This inventory is generated from a local runtime artifact that is not committed to git.
This is an engineering inventory, not a complete legal audit.
The Humble package must include transitive DLLs such as yaml.dll and spdlog.dll or Unity may fail to load rcl.dll. fmt.dll is not part of the current Humble critical runtime closure.

Windows Firewall may block inbound Fast DDS UDP discovery; configure allow rules for DDS ports. Windows ROS2 Humble, properly firewalled WSL2, or a real remote Linux topology should be used for acceptance.
